verdict.rationale: Signifyd's API is major-path-versioned (v3 servers, with V2/V3 webhook targeting). It publishes a backward-compatibility policy stating it only bumps the version for non-backward-compatible changes and lists what counts as compatible. The deprecation half of the story is not delivered: there is no deprecation notice window and no changelog (the changelog URL returns 404). Missing for 10: a documented deprecation policy with notice/sunset windows, a published changelog, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: We only update the version of our API when a non-backward-compatible change is made
Signifyd publishes a downloadable OpenAPI 3.0.3 document ("Signifyd API", version 3.0, servers https://api.signifyd.com/v3)
